title: mfpvector: analysis code and molecular-dynamics run parameters for PFAS sorption to fluoropolymer microplastics
description:
Analysis scripts, molecular-dynamics driver and run parameters (packmol inputs and .mdp files), the umbrella-sampling protocol scripts with their WHAM profiles, bootstrap profiles and window histograms for PFOA on PTFE, PVDF, ECTFE and PE, the docking configuration, the Monte Carlo fluorine mass-balance script (fixed seed 20260710) and the per-replicate interaction-energy outputs supporting the manuscript “Fluorine content does not set PFAS sorption to fluoropolymer microplastics: free-energy anchors and a bound on an unquantified organofluorine pool”.

Raw trajectories are not included. The GAFF2/AM1-BCC topologies, dry slabs, screen cells and all umbrella-window inputs of the PTFE, PVDF and PFOA systems rebuilt in October 2026 are archived (topologies/, slabs/, md_inputs/, archive/); those of the September 2026 screen were lost in a hardware failure, and the deterministic structure-generation and acpype protocol that produced them is archived under code/build/.
